verdict.rationale: Metronome provides APIs for programmatically managing subscription upgrades/downgrades/trials (metronome-docs-6, -29, -30) and mentions a customizable 'in-product billing dashboard' for customer transparency (metronome-docs-11) plus PLG self-serve contract provisioning (metronome-docs-25), but there is no evidence of a ready-made hosted customer portal or pre-built embeddable components that let end customers themselves trigger upgrade/downgrade/cancel actions without the founder building that UI/logic on top of the API. Missing for 10: documented hosted self-service portal, pre-built embeddable upgrade/downgrade/cancel widgets, and evidence customers can cancel without support/engineering intervention.
